summary: Recent updates to WebRender, the GPU compositor in Firefox, focus on enhancing the precision and efficiency of rendering elements on the web. Notably, changes like **snapping transformed border thickness to whole device pixels** improve the clarity of borders and shadows, ensuring they align correctly with the pixel grid for crisp visuals. Adjustments to rendering text and box shadows under various transformations further enhance the visual quality, especially during animations. The updates also involve some cleanup, removing unused code paths and simplifying how pictures are prepared, which can lead to better performance and lower resource usage while browsing. Overall, these changes aim to create a smoother, more visually appealing web experience for users.
